entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return this…thing. This VeloBand Pulse I bought. It’s junk. Doesn’t work half the time.
I understand your frustration, I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [date 15 days ago]. I can certainly help you with a return. I understand you are not satisfied with your purchase.
Not satisfied? It's a piece of garbage! I want my money back. What's the hold up?

I apologize for the inconvenience. Our standard return policy is 90 days for most products. Let me go ahead and process the return for you. You will receive a prepaid shipping label to your email address within 24-48 hours. Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse back, we will issue a full refund to your original method of payment.
90 days? Really? Even for this VeloBand Pulse crap? I thought it was like, 10 days or something. I was sweating bullets because it's been, like, 15 days already.

No worries at all. While some products do have specific return windows, our general policy is 90 days. You are well within that window. Now, regarding the smart watch... are you certain you want to return it? Perhaps there are some troubleshooting steps we can take to resolve the issues you are experiencing?
Nah, I'm good. I'm done with it. Just get the return label sent. And make sure I get my money back. I almost tossed it thinking I missed some stupid 10 days return.

I completely understand. I've initiated the return process. You'll receive that label within 24-48 hours as I mentioned. You will receive your refund once the VeloBand Pulse is received back at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for the help...and for not making me talk to a manager about this. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We value your business. Have a great day!
